description: This file implements a bridge between Chromium DevTools Protocol (CDP) and Browser-Driven Interface (BDI) using the playwright framework. It defines functions and classes to establish and manage connections, transport layers, and message handling between these protocols.

classes.name: BidiTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the BidiTransport interface, managing message handling and connection reference.

classes.name: BidiConnection
classes.description: Manages the bidirectional connection, handling message sending, receiving, and closure.

classes.name: CdpTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements transport over CDP, handling message serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: connectBidiOverCdp
methods.description: Establishes a bidi connection over a CDP transport, setting up necessary classes and event propagation.

methods.name: setOnMessage
methods.description: Sets the message handler for BidiTransportImpl.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through BidiTransport or CdpTransport.
